fees.description: Disconnection fee may apply when vacating your property or if we are required to disconnect your electricity supply. This price is for service in business hours; out of business hours may incur additional fees. Fees are charged by the distributor.

Reconnection fee may apply when reconnecting electricity to your property. This price is for service in business hours; out of business hours may incur additional fees. Fees are charged by the distributor.

discounts.description: Refer someone to sign up to Flipped and if they sign up both you and your referral will receive a $30 credit on your account. Find your referral code in MyAccount or contact Flipped to get your referral code.
